{
  "dataset_name": "phoneme",
  "model_family": "distance_knn",
  "schema_generator": "gpt-5.5-pro",
  "schema_version": "1.0.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "z_center_l2_distance_scaled",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Euclidean distance from the unsupervised training-fold mean profile after per-column standardization, divided by a fold-based upper scale.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.1
      ],
      "feature_family": "standardized_prototype_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Improves radial neighborhood geometry around a generic central prototype.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt((((V1 - 0.8269494139420112) / 0.8751619615160408) ** 2) + (((V2 - 1.2491036397285626) / 0.863725287551349) ** 2) + (((V3 - 0.7392850092535472) / 0.9149811796508119) ** 2) + (((V4 - 0.41070820481184456) / 0.805700948167739) ** 2) + (((V5 - 0.08228932757557063) / 0.5860058896612599) ** 2)) / 7.2"
    },
    {
      "name": "z_center_l1_distance_scaled",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of absolute standardized deviations from the unsupervised mean profile, scaled to a near-unit interval for the training fold.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.1
      ],
      "feature_family": "standardized_prototype_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Adds Manhattan-style robust centrality that can help nearest-neighbor search when one coordinate is noisy.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.abs((V1 - 0.8269494139420112) / 0.8751619615160408) + np.abs((V2 - 1.2491036397285626) / 0.863725287551349) + np.abs((V3 - 0.7392850092535472) / 0.9149811796508119) + np.abs((V4 - 0.41070820481184456) / 0.805700948167739) + np.abs((V5 - 0.08228932757557063) / 0.5860058896612599)) / 16.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "z_center_chebyshev_distance_scaled",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Largest absolute standardized departure from the unsupervised mean profile, scaled by the observed fold span.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.1
      ],
      "feature_family": "standardized_prototype_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Highlights rows dominated by one extreme coordinate, improving local distance shape for outlying contours.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.abs((V1 - 0.8269494139420112) / 0.8751619615160408), np.abs((V2 - 1.2491036397285626) / 0.863725287551349)), np.abs((V3 - 0.7392850092535472) / 0.9149811796508119)), np.abs((V4 - 0.41070820481184456) / 0.805700948167739)), np.abs((V5 - 0.08228932757557063) / 0.5860058896612599)) / 4.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "z_mean_axis_position_scaled",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Signed standardized projection along the common high-versus-low direction across all five measurements.",
      "value_range": [
        -1.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "standardized_projection",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Preserves broad directional shift information that pure distance features discard.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(((V1 - 0.8269494139420112) / 0.8751619615160408) + ((V2 - 1.2491036397285626) / 0.863725287551349) + ((V3 - 0.7392850092535472) / 0.9149811796508119) + ((V4 - 0.41070820481184456) / 0.805700948167739) + ((V5 - 0.08228932757557063) / 0.5860058896612599)) / 16.5"
    },
    {
      "name": "z_adjacent_smoothness_scaled",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Scaled mean absolute adjacent difference across the ordered standardized measurements.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.1
      ],
      "feature_family": "shape_smoothness",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Encodes contour smoothness so rows with similar adjacent transitions are placed nearer together.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.abs(((V2 - 1.2491036397285626) / 0.863725287551349) - ((V1 - 0.8269494139420112) / 0.8751619615160408)) + np.abs(((V3 - 0.7392850092535472) / 0.9149811796508119) - ((V2 - 1.2491036397285626) / 0.863725287551349)) + np.abs(((V4 - 0.41070820481184456) / 0.805700948167739) - ((V3 - 0.7392850092535472) / 0.9149811796508119)) + np.abs(((V5 - 0.08228932757557063) / 0.5860058896612599) - ((V4 - 0.41070820481184456) / 0.805700948167739))) / 24.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "z_adjacent_curvature_scaled",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Scaled average absolute second difference across the ordered standardized measurements.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.1
      ],
      "feature_family": "shape_curvature",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures bends in the acoustic contour, helping KNN align rows with similar local shape.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.abs(((V3 - 0.7392850092535472) / 0.9149811796508119) - (2.0 * ((V2 - 1.2491036397285626) / 0.863725287551349)) + ((V1 - 0.8269494139420112) / 0.8751619615160408)) + np.abs(((V4 - 0.41070820481184456) / 0.805700948167739) - (2.0 * ((V3 - 0.7392850092535472) / 0.9149811796508119)) + ((V2 - 1.2491036397285626) / 0.863725287551349)) + np.abs(((V5 - 0.08228932757557063) / 0.5860058896612599) - (2.0 * ((V4 - 0.41070820481184456) / 0.805700948167739)) + ((V3 - 0.7392850092535472) / 0.9149811796508119))) / 36.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "raw_mean_cosine_similarity",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Cosine similarity between the raw row vector and the unsupervised training-fold mean vector.",
      "value_range": [
        -1.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "prototype_similarity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Adds angle-based similarity that is less sensitive to raw magnitude than Euclidean distance.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "((V1 * 0.8269494139420112) + (V2 * 1.2491036397285626) + (V3 * 0.7392850092535472) + (V4 * 0.41070820481184456) + (V5 * 0.08228932757557063)) / (np.maximum(np.sqrt((V1 ** 2) + (V2 ** 2) + (V3 ** 2) + (V4 ** 2) + (V5 ** 2)), 1e-12) * np.sqrt((0.8269494139420112 ** 2) + (1.2491036397285626 ** 2) + (0.7392850092535472 ** 2) + (0.41070820481184456 ** 2) + (0.08228932757557063 ** 2)))"
    },
    {
      "name": "range_low_corner_distance_scaled",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "RMS distance from the low-value corner of the training-fold bounding box after range scaling and clipping.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "range_prototype_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Anchors neighborhoods with respect to one generic box-corner prototype, improving geometry near low-range regions.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt(((np.clip((V1 + 1.7) / 5.473, 0.0, 1.0) ** 2) + (np.clip((V2 + 1.279) / 4.872, 0.0, 1.0) ** 2) + (np.clip((V3 + 1.3) / 4.411, 0.0, 1.0) ** 2) + (np.clip((V4 + 1.581) / 4.366, 0.0, 1.0) ** 2) + (np.clip((V5 + 1.284) / 3.684, 0.0, 1.0) ** 2)) / 5.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "range_high_corner_distance_scaled",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "RMS distance from the high-value corner of the training-fold bounding box after range scaling and clipping.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "range_prototype_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a complementary generic box-corner distance that helps KNN respect boundary-side similarity.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt(((np.clip((3.773 - V1) / 5.473, 0.0, 1.0) ** 2) + (np.clip((3.593 - V2) / 4.872, 0.0, 1.0) ** 2) + (np.clip((3.111 - V3) / 4.411, 0.0, 1.0) ** 2) + (np.clip((2.785 - V4) / 4.366, 0.0, 1.0) ** 2) + (np.clip((2.4 - V5) / 3.684, 0.0, 1.0) ** 2)) / 5.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "central_core_indicator",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Binary flag for rows lying within one standard deviation of the training-fold mean in every measurement.",
      "value_range": [
        0,
        1
      ],
      "feature_family": "unsupervised_region_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Adds a coarse central-region marker that can stabilize local neighborhoods around dense areas.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where((np.abs((V1 - 0.8269494139420112) / 0.8751619615160408) <= 1.0) & (np.abs((V2 - 1.2491036397285626) / 0.863725287551349) <= 1.0) & (np.abs((V3 - 0.7392850092535472) / 0.9149811796508119) <= 1.0) & (np.abs((V4 - 0.41070820481184456) / 0.805700948167739) <= 1.0) & (np.abs((V5 - 0.08228932757557063) / 0.5860058896612599) <= 1.0), 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "outer_shell_indicator",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Binary flag for rows with at least one measurement beyond two standard deviations from its training-fold mean.",
      "value_range": [
        0,
        1
      ],
      "feature_family": "unsupervised_region_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Identifies edge-region rows so nearest-neighbor distances can account for sparse outer-shell behavior.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where((np.abs((V1 - 0.8269494139420112) / 0.8751619615160408) >= 2.0) | (np.abs((V2 - 1.2491036397285626) / 0.863725287551349) >= 2.0) | (np.abs((V3 - 0.7392850092535472) / 0.9149811796508119) >= 2.0) | (np.abs((V4 - 0.41070820481184456) / 0.805700948167739) >= 2.0) | (np.abs((V5 - 0.08228932757557063) / 0.5860058896612599) >= 2.0), 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "phoneme_contour_coherence_judgment",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "A 0-1 expert score derived from the five ordered acoustic measurements that rates whether the contour looks internally coherent, smooth, and plausible relative to unsupervised training-fold ranges.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "semantic_similarity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Supplies a soft contour-level similarity cue for neighbor ranking when formula distances miss perceptual shape cues.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
